input.idea: samograph.dev — a hosted SaaS wrapping the existing samograph CLI and its Recall.ai meeting bot, so users never run the CLI, manage a Recall token, or set up an ngrok/cloudflared tunnel. Users sign in via email magic-link or Google, connect Google Calendar, and the platform auto-joins their meetings with a bot (everyone with the link). One shared Recall token is managed server-side. During a call, a per-call page in the user's account streams the LIVE transcript over WebSocket (word-by-word, like chat, no reload); the page link is shareable so others can follow the live read-along (useful for hard accents). Custom dictionary/words configurable. Transcripts persist to the user's DB in real time for long-term storage (Recall keeps video only ~7 days free). v1 bot is deliberately 'thin' (no AI, just ingest audio/video + stream/store transcript) and already beats current paid tools. v2: synced transcript+video viewer (click a word to jump, YouTube-like), cheap long-term video storage, consistent bot identities, post-call email of transcript to all participants, multi-language UI. Output a spec organized as user stories with explicit v1 (next week) and v2 (later) sections plus open questions/risks (storage cost, shared-token tenant isolation, auth/calendar scope, shareable-link security, consent/recording disclosure).
